name: Restaurants & Food Service
tagline: Net sales, bills, covers, average bill and spend per cover, menu mix, discounts and delivery-app orders for restaurants, cafés and cloud kitchens
description: Bill-wise and item-wise sales reports, KOT registers and table or covers reports from restaurant POS systems (Petpooja, Posist, Rista, DotPe, Toast, Square for Restaurants, Lightspeed, TouchBistro, Revel, Oracle Simphony), and order and payout exports from delivery-app partner dashboards (Swiggy, Zomato, Uber Eats, DoorDash, Deliveroo, Grubhub).

fields.label: Bill / order number
fields.description: Identifies each bill (check); an item-wise report repeats it on every item line.

fields.label: KOT number
fields.description: Kitchen order ticket; one bill can carry several KOTs.

fields.label: Covers / guests
fields.description: Guests served on the bill; item-wise reports may repeat it on every line, so it is counted once per bill.

fields.label: Discount %
fields.description: A discount rate written on each bill or line; Discount % is recomputed from amounts, never averaged from this column.

fields.label: Net sales
fields.description: Sales after discounts, before taxes, service charges and tips; on an item-wise report, the line amount.

fields.label: Item price
fields.description: Menu price per unit; never summed, only used to rebuild sales.

fields.label: Bills (count)
fields.description: Bills per row in a daily or outlet summary; summed, never counted.

subDomains.name: Bills & checks
subDomains.description: One row per bill (check) from the restaurant POS with date and time, covers, table, order type, server, payment mode, discount, tax and bill total; a daily outlet summary with bill and cover counts fits here too.

subDomains.name: Item-wise sales (menu mix)
subDomains.description: One row per menu item on a bill or KOT, with the item, its menu category, quantity, price and amount.

subDomains.name: Delivery-app orders
subDomains.description: One row per order from a delivery app's partner dashboard (Swiggy, Zomato, Uber Eats, DoorDash), with order status, item total, packaging charges, discounts, commission, payout, kitchen prep time and rating.

kpis.name: Net sales (all bills)
kpis.definition: Net sales on every bill, before removing cancelled and complimentary bills.
kpis.formula: Σ net sales (or gross − discount, bill total − tax, quantity × price) across all bills

variants.label: Gross sales − discount
variants.caveat: No net sales column, so net sales are gross sales less discounts.

variants.label: Bill total − tax
variants.caveat: No net sales column, so net sales are the bill total less tax; service charges, packaging and tips may still be in it.

variants.label: Quantity × item price
variants.caveat: No sales amount column, so sales are quantity × menu price, before any discount.

variants.label: Gross sales
variants.caveat: Only gross sales are available, so discounts are not taken off.

variants.label: Bill total
variants.caveat: Only a bill total is available, so sales include any taxes, service charges and tips.

kpis.name: Bills (all statuses)
kpis.definition: Bills raised, including cancelled, void and complimentary bills.
kpis.formula: Count of distinct bill numbers (or Σ bill counts in a summary)

variants.label: Bill count column
variants.caveat: Bills are summed from the file's bill count column.

variants.label: Row count (no bill number)
variants.caveat: No bill number column, so every row is counted as one bill. Check the grain.

kpis.name: Covers (all bills)
kpis.definition: Guests on every bill, counted once per bill, before removing cancelled bills.
kpis.formula: Σ covers per bill

variants.label: Σ covers
variants.caveat: No bill number, so covers are summed row by row; check that they are not repeated on every item line.

kpis.name: Discounts (all bills)
kpis.definition: Discounts given on every bill, before removing cancelled and complimentary bills.
kpis.formula: Σ discount

kpis.name: Gross sales (all bills)
kpis.definition: Sales before discounts on every bill, before removing cancelled and complimentary bills.
kpis.formula: Σ gross sales (or net sales + discounts)

variants.label: Net sales + discount
variants.caveat: No gross sales column, so gross sales are net sales plus discounts.

kpis.name: Net sales
kpis.definition: Sales after discounts and before taxes, service charges and tips, on bills that were not cancelled, void or complimentary.
kpis.formula: Σ net sales, excluding cancelled and complimentary bills

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so sales are taken as recorded; any cancelled or void bills are included.

pitfalls: Net sales leave out taxes, service charges, packaging and tips; the POS day-end report may show a gross or grand total instead, so reconcile on the same basis.

kpis.name: Bills
kpis.definition: Bills settled in the period, excluding cancelled, void and complimentary bills.
kpis.formula: Count of distinct bill numbers, excluding cancelled and complimentary bills

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so every bill is counted, including any cancelled or void ones.

kpis.name: Delivered orders
kpis.definition: Delivery-app orders that were not cancelled, rejected or timed out.
kpis.formula: Count of distinct order IDs, excluding cancelled and rejected orders

variants.label: All orders
variants.caveat: No order status, so every order is counted, including any cancelled or rejected ones.

kpis.name: Average bill value
kpis.definition: Net sales per settled bill.
kpis.formula: Net sales ÷ bills
pitfalls: Average bill value is net sales ÷ bills; averaging a bill-total column would mix in taxes and over-weight small groups.

kpis.name: Average delivery order value
kpis.definition: Net sales per delivered order.
kpis.formula: Net sales ÷ delivered orders

kpis.name: Covers
kpis.definition: Guests served, counted once per bill, on bills that were not cancelled or void.
kpis.formula: Σ covers per bill, excluding cancelled bills

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so covers on any cancelled bills are included.

pitfalls: Takeaway and delivery bills often carry no covers, so covers describe dine-in trade only.

kpis.name: Average spend per cover
kpis.definition: Net sales per guest served.
kpis.formula: Net sales ÷ covers
pitfalls: When takeaway and delivery bills have no covers, their sales still count in net sales; filter to dine-in for a true spend per head.

kpis.name: Items sold
kpis.definition: Menu items sold on bills that were not cancelled, void or complimentary.
kpis.formula: Σ quantity, excluding cancelled and complimentary bills

variants.label: All lines
variants.caveat: No bill status, so items on any cancelled bills are included.

variants.label: Row count (no quantity)
variants.caveat: No quantity column, so each item line counts as one item.

kpis.name: Items per bill
kpis.definition: Menu items sold per settled bill.
kpis.formula: Items sold ÷ bills

kpis.name: Discount %
kpis.definition: Discounts as a share of sales before discount, on bills that were not cancelled or complimentary.
kpis.formula: Σ discount ÷ gross sales, excluding cancelled and complimentary bills

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so discounts on any cancelled or complimentary bills are included.

pitfalls: Complimentary bills are left out: recorded as a 100% discount they would otherwise swamp the rate. Track them with Complimentary bills %.

kpis.name: Order cancellation rate
kpis.definition: Share of bills or orders that were cancelled, voided, rejected or timed out.
kpis.formula: Cancelled bills ÷ all bills
pitfalls: On delivery apps, rejections and time-outs by the restaurant hurt its ranking more than cancellations by customers; split them with the cancellation reason.

kpis.name: Platform commission %
kpis.definition: Delivery-app commission and platform fees as a share of net sales, on orders that were not cancelled.
kpis.formula: Σ commission ÷ net sales, excluding cancelled orders

variants.label: All orders
variants.caveat: No order status, so cancelled orders are included.

pitfalls: Platforms charge commission on different bases (before or after restaurant discounts, with or without packaging), so compare platforms on the same base.

kpis.name: Average kitchen prep time
kpis.definition: Average minutes the kitchen took to prepare an order, from acceptance or KOT to food ready.
kpis.formula: Average of kitchen prep time in minutes, excluding cancelled orders

variants.label: All orders
variants.caveat: No order status, so prep times of cancelled orders are included.

kpis.name: Gross sales
kpis.definition: Sales before discounts, on bills that were not cancelled or complimentary.
kpis.formula: Σ gross sales (or net sales + discounts), excluding cancelled and complimentary bills

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so any cancelled or complimentary bills are included.

kpis.name: Discounts
kpis.definition: Discounts given on bills that were not cancelled or complimentary.
kpis.formula: Σ discount, excluding cancelled and complimentary bills

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so discounts on any cancelled or complimentary bills are included.

kpis.name: Table turns per day
kpis.definition: Dine-in bills per table per trading day, counting the tables that appear in the data.
kpis.formula: Bills with a table ÷ (tables used × days from the first to the last bill)

variants.label: Bills with a table ÷ (tables × days)
variants.caveat: Tables are those that appear in the data, and every day from the first to the last bill counts as a trading day.

pitfalls: Closed days still count as trading days, and tables never used in the period are left out; both move the figure, so compare like periods.

kpis.name: Delivery share of sales
kpis.definition: Share of net sales from delivery orders.
kpis.formula: Net sales on delivery orders ÷ net sales

kpis.name: Aggregator share of sales
kpis.definition: Share of net sales from orders placed through delivery apps such as Swiggy, Zomato or Uber Eats.
kpis.formula: Net sales on delivery-app orders ÷ net sales
pitfalls: App orders carry commission, so a rising aggregator share can lift sales while lowering margin.

kpis.name: Beverage share of sales
kpis.definition: Share of net sales from beverage menu categories (drinks, bar, coffee and the like).
kpis.formula: Net sales on beverage categories ÷ net sales
pitfalls: Check which categories count as beverages in Check & map › Value meanings; a combo with a drink stays food.

kpis.name: Complimentary bills %
kpis.definition: Share of bills marked complimentary or non-chargeable (NC).
kpis.formula: Complimentary bills ÷ all bills

kpis.name: Average order rating
kpis.definition: Average rating customers gave their order or visit.
kpis.formula: Average of rating over rated orders
pitfalls: Only some orders are rated, and unhappy customers rate more often; read the count of ratings with the average.

kpis.name: Average delivery time (minutes)
kpis.definition: Average minutes from order to delivery, on orders that were not cancelled.
kpis.formula: Average of delivery time in minutes, excluding cancelled orders

variants.label: All orders
variants.caveat: No order status, so cancelled orders are included.

kpis.name: Average rider wait time
kpis.definition: Average minutes delivery riders waited at the restaurant for the order to be ready.
kpis.formula: Average of rider wait time in minutes

kpis.name: Payout %
kpis.definition: Net payout received from the delivery app as a share of net sales, on orders that were not cancelled.
kpis.formula: Σ payout ÷ net sales, excluding cancelled orders

variants.label: All orders
variants.caveat: No order status, so cancelled orders are included.

pitfalls: Payouts can include compensation for cancelled orders and deductions for penalties, so a payout over 100% of an order's sales is possible.

kpis.name: Tip %
kpis.definition: Tips as a share of net sales, on bills that were not cancelled or complimentary.
kpis.formula: Σ tips ÷ net sales

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so every bill is included.

kpis.name: Average item price
kpis.definition: Net sales per menu item sold.
kpis.formula: Net sales ÷ items sold

kpis.name: Covers per bill
kpis.definition: Guests served per settled bill.
kpis.formula: Covers ÷ bills

kpis.name: Orders placed
kpis.definition: Delivery-app orders received, whatever happened to them, including cancelled and rejected orders.
kpis.formula: Count of distinct order IDs, all statuses

kpis.name: Cancelled bills
kpis.definition: Bills or orders that were cancelled, voided, rejected or timed out.
kpis.formula: Count of distinct bills with a cancelled status

kpis.name: Service charge collected
kpis.definition: Service charges on bills that were not cancelled or complimentary.
kpis.formula: Σ service charge, excluding cancelled and complimentary bills

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so every bill is included.

kpis.name: Tips
kpis.definition: Tips left on bills that were not cancelled.
kpis.formula: Σ tips, excluding cancelled bills

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so every bill is included.

kpis.name: Total billed
kpis.definition: Bill totals including taxes and charges, on bills that were not cancelled or complimentary.
kpis.formula: Σ bill total, excluding cancelled and complimentary bills

variants.label: All bills
variants.caveat: No bill status, so every bill is included.

kpis.name: Packaging charges collected
kpis.definition: Packaging and container charges on orders that were not cancelled.
kpis.formula: Σ packaging charges, excluding cancelled orders

variants.label: All orders
variants.caveat: No order status, so every order is included.

kpis.name: Commission paid
kpis.definition: Commission and platform fees charged by delivery apps on orders that were not cancelled.
kpis.formula: Σ commission, excluding cancelled orders

variants.label: All orders
variants.caveat: No order status, so every order is included.

kpis.name: Outlets
kpis.definition: Distinct outlets or restaurants with sales in the period.
kpis.formula: Count of distinct outlets

kpis.name: Menu items sold
kpis.definition: Distinct menu items that sold at least once in the period.
kpis.formula: Count of distinct menu items

charts.title: Net sales over time
charts.reason: One sales measure over continuous time: the soft fill shows volume without hiding the weekly and seasonal shape.

charts.title: Average bill value over time
charts.reason: Average bill value is a ratio, so it is recomputed per period (net sales ÷ bills) and drawn as a line, never summed.

charts.title: Covers over time
charts.reason: Covers per period are counts of guests, so columns from a zero baseline compare them honestly.

charts.title: Spend per cover over time
charts.reason: Spend per cover is a ratio, recomputed per period from net sales and covers and drawn as a line.

charts.title: Delivered orders over time
charts.reason: Orders per period are discrete counts, so columns from a zero baseline compare them honestly.

charts.title: Average order value over time
charts.reason: Average order value is a ratio, so it is recomputed per period and drawn as a line.

charts.title: Kitchen prep time over time
charts.reason: An average time per period, drawn as a line so a slowing kitchen shows as a rising trend.

charts.title: Net sales by order type
charts.reason: A few order types (dine-in, takeaway, delivery) as parts of all sales: a donut shows the mix at a glance.

charts.title: Net sales by outlet
charts.reason: One measure across named outlets: sorted horizontal bars keep the names readable. Top 10 plus Others.

charts.title: Net sales by meal period
charts.reason: Sales across a handful of meal periods (breakfast, lunch, dinner): columns compare them from a zero baseline.

charts.title: Net sales by payment mode
charts.reason: Part-to-whole across a few payment modes: a donut shows the cash, card and UPI split.

charts.title: Net sales by delivery platform
charts.reason: One measure across named platforms: sorted horizontal bars compare Swiggy, Zomato and the rest directly.

charts.title: Orders by status
charts.reason: A few statuses (delivered, cancelled, rejected) as parts of all orders: a donut shows the split.

charts.title: Top menu items by net sales
charts.reason: One measure across many named dishes: sorted horizontal bars of the top 15 keep long names readable.

charts.title: Net sales by menu category and item
charts.reason: A two-level part-to-whole (category, then dish): a treemap shows where sales sit and lets you drill in.

charts.title: Most-ordered menu items
charts.reason: Quantity sold by dish: sorted bars show the menu's workhorses, which may differ from its top earners.

charts.title: Net sales by veg / non-veg
charts.reason: Two or three diet types as parts of all sales: a donut shows the split.

charts.title: Bills by hour and weekday
charts.reason: When are the rushes? Bills per hour of day and weekday on one grid show service peaks for staffing and prep.

charts.title: Net sales by weekday
charts.reason: Seven ordered weekdays and one measure: columns show the weekday-versus-weekend rhythm.

charts.title: How big bills are
charts.reason: The spread of bill sizes: a histogram of bills per value band shows whether a few large parties drive the average.

charts.title: Discount % by outlet
charts.reason: A rate compared across outlets: sorted bars of the recomputed discount %, with outlets under 30 bills hidden as too small.

charts.title: How much of sales the top dishes make
charts.reason: Menu concentration: items sorted by sales with the running share shows how few dishes carry the menu.

charts.title: Cancellation rate by platform
charts.reason: A rate compared across platforms: sorted bars of the recomputed rate, with platforms under 30 orders hidden as too small.

charts.title: Why orders are cancelled
charts.reason: Reasons sorted by count with the running share show which few causes account for most cancellations.

charts.title: How long deliveries take
charts.reason: The spread of delivery times: a histogram shows the slow tail that an average hides.

charts.title: Delivered orders by hour
charts.reason: Ordered hours of the day and one count: columns show the lunch and dinner peaks.

charts.title: Outlet scorecard
charts.reason: Several measures per outlet, read side by side: a sortable table compares sales, bills, covers and spend per head.

charts.title: Server scorecard
charts.reason: Sales, bills and average bill per server or steward in one sortable table, for coaching and incentives.

charts.title: Menu item performance
charts.reason: Quantity, sales and average price per dish in one sortable table: the starting point for menu engineering.

pitfalls: Net sales leave out taxes, service charges, packaging, delivery charges and tips; POS day-end reports may show a gross or grand total instead, so reconcile on the same basis.
Cancelled, void and complimentary (NC) bills are left out of sales, bills and averages; check which statuses count as each in Check & map › Value meanings.
An item-wise report repeats each bill on many rows: bills are counted as distinct bill numbers and covers once per bill, never summed per line.
Delivery-app orders often appear twice, once in the POS and again in the app's own export; analyse one source, never both added together.
Late-night bills after midnight land on the next calendar date unless the file carries a business date.
